en.title: Claude
en.description: Claude is Anthropic's AI, built for problem solvers. Tackle complex challenges, analyze data, write code, and think through your hardest work.
en.detail:
### What is Claude?

Claude is Anthropic’s advanced conversational AI platform designed to help individuals and teams think faster, build smarter, and collaborate more efficiently. Powered by state‑of‑the‑art large language models such as ### Opus, ### Sonnet, and ### Haiku, Claude can generate text, write code, analyze data, create visual content, and even browse the web for up‑to‑date information. Whether you’re drafting a report, debugging software, brainstorming ideas, or summarizing meeting transcripts, Claude delivers reliable, context‑aware assistance across desktop, mobile, and browser extensions.

---

### Key Features of Claude

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| ### Multimodal Understanding | Analyze text ### and images, extract insights from PDFs, screenshots, and charts. |
| ### Code Generation & Execution | Write, refactor, and run code in dozens of languages; visualize data instantly. |
| ### Web‑Enabled Answers | Real‑time web search for the latest facts, citations, and references. |
| ### Memory Across Sessions | Claude retains relevant context across conversations, reducing repetitive prompts. |
| ### Claude in Chrome & Excel | Seamless browser and spreadsheet extensions let you summon AI without leaving your workflow. |
| ### Claude in PowerPoint & Slack | Generate slide decks, summarize meetings, and push updates directly to collaboration tools. |
| ### AI Agents & Automation | Build custom agents that can trigger actions, fetch files, or interact with APIs. |
| ### Extended Thinking | Handles complex, multi‑step problems with higher reasoning depth than standard chat models. |
| ### Secure Enterprise Controls | Role‑based access, data residency options, and audit logs for regulated industries. |
| ### Free AI Tool Submission | Community members can submit new AI utilities to the Claude ecosystem at no cost. |

---

### How to Use Claude

1. ### Create an Account – Sign up via email, Google SSO, or corporate SSO.  
2. ### Choose Your Platform – Access Claude on the web, iOS, Android, or download the desktop app for Windows/macOS.  
3. ### Install Extensions – Add Claude to Chrome, Excel, PowerPoint, or Slack to invoke AI directly from those apps.  
4. ### Start a Conversation – Type a prompt, upload a file, or paste code. Claude will respond with text, code snippets, or visual outputs.  
5. ### Leverage Connectors – Link Claude to Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, or custom APIs for real‑time data retrieval.  
6. ### Upgrade When Needed – If you exceed free usage limits, switch to a paid plan for higher quotas and priority access.  

*Pro tip:* Use Claude’s ### “Memory” feature to store project briefs or style guides, so every new request automatically follows your preferred tone and format.

---

### Pricing Plans

| Plan | Monthly Cost* | Key Benefits |
|------|---------------|--------------|
| ### Free | $0 | Unlimited chat on web, iOS, Android, and desktop; basic usage limits; access to Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku models. |
| ### Pro | $17 (annual) / $20 (monthly) | 5–20× higher usage than Free; Claude Code for unlimited projects; access to research memory; priority support; Claude in Chrome, Excel, PowerPoint. |
| ### Max | From $100/month (billed monthly) | 5× or 20× Pro usage multiplier; higher output limits; early access to advanced features; dedicated account manager for teams. |
| ### Enterprise | Custom pricing | Unlimited usage, SLA guarantees, on‑premise deployment options, advanced security & compliance, single sign‑on (SSO) integration. |

\*All prices are shown without applicable taxes. Annual subscriptions are billed upfront and provide a discount over month‑to‑month billing.

---

### Helpful Tips for Getting the Most Out of Claude

- ### Batch Prompts: Combine related questions in a single prompt to conserve usage credits.  
- ### Use the Chrome Extension: Highlight text on any webpage and press ### Ctrl+Shift+L to summon Claude instantly.  
- ### Enable “Memory”: Save recurring project details (e.g., brand voice, coding standards) so Claude auto‑applies them.  
- ### Integrate with Slack: Set up Claude as a bot to get instant answers in team channels without switching apps.  
- ### Leverage Web Search: When you need up‑to‑date statistics, add “search the web” to your prompt for live results.  
- ### Explore AI Agents: Build simple agents that can pull data from your CRM or schedule meetings in Google Calendar.  
- ### Monitor Usage: The dashboard shows daily token consumption; set alerts to avoid unexpected overages.  
- ### Take Advantage of Free Credits: Use the daily free GPT‑4o‑style conversations for document analysis before hitting limits.  

---

### Frequently Asked Questions

### Q: What is Claude and how does it work?  
A: Claude is an AI assistant built on Anthropic’s large language models. It processes natural language prompts, accesses web data when needed, and returns text, code, or visual outputs while maintaining context across sessions.

### Q: Who should use Claude?  
A: Claude serves everyone—from solo freelancers drafting blog posts to large enterprises automating workflow, developers writing code, analysts visualizing data, and educators creating lesson plans.

### Q: How much does Claude cost?  
A: Claude offers a free tier with basic limits. Paid plans start at $17/month (annual) for Pro, $100/month for Max, and custom pricing for Enterprise. Higher tiers provide expanded usage, priority access, and additional features.

### Q: Is there a limit on free usage?  
A: Yes. The Free plan includes a daily quota of GPT‑4o‑style conversations and a modest number of image generations. Exceeding the quota prompts you to upgrade or wait until the next day.

### Q: Can I generate images with Claude?  
A: While Claude excels at text and code, its integrated DALL·E‑style capabilities (via extensions) let you create images from prompts, sharing credits with the text model for a seamless experience.

### Q: How does Claude protect my data?  
A: Anthropic does not use your conversation data to train its models unless you explicitly opt‑in. All data can be deleted on request, and Enterprise customers can enforce strict data residency and encryption policies.

### Q: What happens if I cancel my subscription?  
A: Cancel anytime through the account dashboard. Your data will be retained for 30 days for export, after which it is permanently deleted unless you choose otherwise.

### Q: How do I get priority support?  
A: Pro and higher tiers include priority email support. Enterprise customers receive a dedicated account manager and 24/7 SLA‑backed assistance.

### Q: Can Claude be used offline?  
A: Currently Claude requires an internet connection to access the cloud‑based models and web search features. Offline capabilities are planned for future enterprise releases.
